verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for an API product like Financial Connections, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one. The probes show markdown docs, llms.txt, an MCP server and a CLI, and the OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404. Test-mode institutions are a testing feature, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
